description: Published DCS request attributes and identity pairs. Every generic DCS field is optional; d_rtbd=json requests a JSON response. Visitor ID-specific version andorganization requirements are handled by the ECID pack.

params.name: d_mid
params.description: It is an existing ECID. Adobe's reuse call sends d_mid with d_ver=2.
params.fix_hint: Send d_mid when you already have an Experience Cloud ID for the visitor.

params.name: d_cid
params.description: Provider ID or integration code with user ID separated by %01. Single pairs may include0/1/2authentication state. The generic DCS table permits multiple provider/user pairs in one parameter; the CID guide also permits repeated keys.

params.name: d_cb
params.description: The vendor documents `d_cb` in the request contract.

params.name: d_cid_ic
params.description: Provider ID or integration code with user ID separated by %01. Single pairs may include0/1/2authentication state. The generic DCS table permits multiple provider/user pairs in one parameter; the CID guide also permits repeated keys.

params.name: d_caller
params.description: Caller identification; no published character grammar.

params.name: d_coppa
params.description: Disables third-party-cookie use. Published table specifies behavior without a complete literal-value enum.

params.name: d_cts
params.description: Optional account-enabled traits/segments return mode:1legacy segment IDs or2current IDs.

params.name: d_dpid
params.description: Deprecated data provider ID, still supported in ID and event calls.

params.name: d_dpuuid
params.description: Deprecated provider-specific user ID, still supported in ID and event calls.

params.name: d_dst
params.description: Include URL destination data in a JSON response.

params.name: d_dst_filter
params.description: Reserved Analytics/Audience Manager integration attribute with unpublished value grammar.

params.name: d_jsonv
params.description: Response JSON version1;0disables ID syncs.

params.name: d_nsid
params.description: JavaScript container namespace used by DIL for ID synchronization; account namespace registration is external.

params.name: d_ptfm
params.description: Published platform literal registry.

params.name: d_rs
params.description: Deprecated reserved Analytics/Audience Manager attribute, without a published value grammar.

params.name: d_rtbd
params.description: JSON response selector. Required when a JSON response is requested; absence returns a pixel.

params.name: d_sid

params.name: d_uuid

params.description: Public customer-defined DCS attribute. The key prefix is published; the value schema is configured by the customer.
